text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(――...My body. It feels so much lighter 
than before――!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, I can do this! Taaahhh--!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank goodness. I was able to run 
just the way I envisioned.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Even past the final corner, my legs moved 
just the way I wanted them to, and...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
All your hard work up to this point has 
surely borne fruit.
choice_data_list: Yeah! You did a fantastic job.

text_block_list.text:
I nodded firmly at her words. In her 
races, she was showing even greater growth 
than before, having broken out of her 
shell.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. It's all thanks to 
you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring) is nearly four 
furlongs longer than the Nikkei Sho, but— 
we've finally seen a glimmer of hope.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Next up is finally the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I hope that together with you, Trainer, we 
can gather a harvest of victories.
(Clap clap clap clap...!)

And so, the Nikkei Sho concluded with 
newfound hope— and at last, the days 
leading up to the Tenno Sho (Spring) began 
in earnest!

"In the end, that doubt I harbored during 
winter— that I might not be strong enough 
to support her— pathetically, I couldn't 
completely shake it off."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, I can do this! Taaahhh--!!

She had grown far stronger and achieved 
tremendous progress.

Claiming the Tenno Sho (Spring). What once 
felt like a lofty, unreachable goal has 
been brought firmly into reach by today's 
result.

—For a Tiara route Umamusume, achieving 
great results in the Tenno Sho (Spring) 
will undoubtedly bring brilliance to her.

To make her dream come true, and for the 
sake of her brilliance—

I want to support her with everything I 
have.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, phew...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (I am growing. However—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I'm still not good enough to claim that 
special flower. Besides—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "Don't go anywhere—!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Ever since then, time and time again—even 
this morning, once more. I had... that 
dream again.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Even Trainer... looks troubled 
sometimes.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(We can never know what the future holds. 
It might just be needless worry.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—Even if, by some chance, that became 
reality... I won't let you get away like 
this.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I will... absolutely—! I'll make sure to 
give you those special flowers!)

"The next race is the Tenno Sho (Spring) 
in one month. There is no time to stand 
still."
